name: gilded_lotus_three_mana_of_the_chosen_color
notes: M8 mapper. Printed: '{T}: Add three mana of any one color.' Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The Lotus pays Llanowar Elves' {G}: it makes three green, one is spent, and the other two stay in the pool (no step ends to empty them).
